senses.gloss: f. (יָדַע) knowledge, esp. (Lev. IV, 14; 23; 28) finding out, discovery, consciousness.
units: <cite ref="Shevuot 5a:13">Shebu. 5ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>יְרִיעַת בית רבו שמה י׳</he> the knowledge acquired in the teacher’s house (a theoretical knowledge that one who touches an unclean thing becomes unclean &c.) is also called a knowledge (as regards the applicability of the verb <cite ref="P00820"><he>נעלם</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Mishnah Keritot 4:2">Ker. IV, 2</cite> <he>אם היתה י׳ בנתיים</he> if there was consciousness between the two acts (if he found out his first transgression before committing the second).

<cite ref="Mishnah Shevuot 1:2">Shebu. I, 2</cite> <he>י׳ בתחלה וי׳ בסוף והעלם בנתיים</he> original consciousness (knowing that he became unclean) and final consciousness (finding out that he had eaten sacred things in uncleanness) but forgetfulness between.

<cite ref="Horayot 2a">Hor. 2ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>השב מִידִיעָתוֹ</he> he who regrets when he finds out his transgression; a. fr.—Pl. <he>יְדִיעוֹת</he>. Sheb. I, 1 <he>י׳ הטומאה</he> the laws concerning the discovery of having sinned through uncleanness; <cite ref="Mishnah Horayot 2:1">ib. II, 1</cite>; a. fr.
